_readme: Every reward, price and shop rule lives here. Edit numbers, save, reload the game. The game reads 'rewards', 'events' and 'shop'. All shop items below are PLACEHOLDER test data - names, prices and effects are just there so the shop has something to show (effects are not applied yet). See docs/ECONOMY.md for what every field means, and run 'py tools/economy_report.py' for a quick balance table.

rewards._note: The base coins for hitting each window come from the projectile in use - see 'projectiles' below (rewards.W20 / rewards.W21). The streak is only a counter now: it adds no coins.

_aimNote: Speed of the two aim markers (offset and strength - always the same, fixed speed). markerHz = full back-and-forth sweeps per second (0.85 = one sweep in ~1.2s). Nothing changes it: not the streak, not buffs, not the projectile.
_projectilesNote: Gameplay numbers for every projectile you can equip (the id must match its shop item / its entry in the PROJECTILES list). infinite: true = never runs out (the snowball); every other projectile is a CONSUMABLE: one is used up the moment the player taps 'TAP to aim', and when the last one is gone the snowball is equipped again. rewards: the BASE coins for a hit on W20 / W21 with this projectile (streak and face bonuses are added on top). weight: NOT shown to the player - heavier projectiles fly lower with the same throw strength (100 = the reference snowball; 75 flies 33% higher). angleRange: how far the throw can drift sideways (1 = the full swing, 0.8 = only 80% as far); the aim bar keeps its width and shows this range edge to edge, so its graduation lines look stretched on a smaller range. The marker speed is the same for everything. leavesMark: false = no snow mark, it bounces off instead. spins: it rotates in flight.

shop._priceOverrideNote: PLACEHOLDER: while priceOverride is a number, EVERY item costs that many coins in the shop (so we can test buying). Set it to null to use each item's real 'price' below.
shop._restockNote: After buying, that slot shows SOLD OUT for this many seconds (by the device clock, so it also counts while the app is closed), then restocks. 60 = 1 minute for testing; 3600 = 1 hour.

refill._categoryWeightsNote: Odds of each TYPE when a slot is (re)stocked: projectile 1 vs consumable 9 = a projectile shows up about 1 time in 10. Then an item of that type is picked at random.

shop._itemsNote: Empty slots show (TBD) - the shop only has real items now. Optional item field image = a picture path for the card. Consumables are timed BUFFS: bought = active right away for duration.seconds, with a list of effects (guideLines, precision, strengthControl, coinMultiplier - see src/buffs.js). category is 'consumable' (a timed buff: can be on sale in several slots at once; needs a duration) or 'projectile' (a stack of consumable projectiles: each time it is put on sale the amount (amount.min..max) and the price of ONE (unitPrice.min..max) are rolled at random, the slot's price is amount x unitPrice; never on sale in two slots at once).
